description: Flow 1, two agents in one workspace: two Rust agents as one user with distinct IDs, ports, tokens and instance roots and OPUTE_MCP_PREFIX_TOOL_NAMES=true; each publishes only its own prefixed names and the /health prefix; a third process on the first agent's instance root is refused as D25 specifies while the first keeps serving.

inputs.agent: two Rust agents started for the journey under /tmp/e2e-agents (ports 3021, 3022)

requirements.requirement: OPUTE_MCP_PREFIX_TOOL_NAMES: prefix wire tool names for multi-agent IDE workspaces

requirements.scenario: Two agents share a physical machine

requirements.requirement: One running agent per instance state

pass.equals: host agent instance is already in use: /tmp/e2e-agents/ws-a/instance/host-agent.lock is locked by another process

requirements.scenario: A second agent on the same instance root

steps.guest: python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start ws-a --port 3021 --id e2e-ws-a --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:wsa} --env OPUTE_MCP_PREFIX_TOOL_NAMES=true
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start ws-b --port 3022 --id e2e-ws-b --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:wsb} --env OPUTE_MCP_PREFIX_TOOL_NAMES=true

python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/mcpwire.py <<'EOF' > /tmp/e2e-j6-a.json
{"kind": "mcp", "port": 3021, "token": "${SECRET:wsa}", "method": "tools/list"}
EOF
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/mcpwire.py <<'EOF' > /tmp/e2e-j6-b.json
{"kind": "mcp", "port": 3022, "token": "${SECRET:wsb}", "method": "tools/list"}
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
na = [t['name'] for t in json.load(open('/tmp/e2e-j6-a.json'))['body']['result']['tools']]
nb = [t['name'] for t in json.load(open('/tmp/e2e-j6-b.json'))['body']['result']['tools']]
pa, pb = '${PA}', '${PB}'
print(json.dumps({'countA': len(na), 'countB': len(nb), 'allPrefixedA': all(n.startswith(pa + '_') for n in na), 'allPrefixedB': all(n.startswith(pb + '_') for n in nb), 'overlap': len(set(na) & set(nb)), 'prefixesDiffer': pa != pb, 'unprefixedA': sorted({n[len(pa) + 1:] for n in na}) == sorted({n[len(pb) + 1:] for n in nb})}))
EOF
rm -f /tmp/e2e-j6-a.json /tmp/e2e-j6-b.json

runuser -u opute -- env OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-ws-a MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:wsa} HOST_MCP_PORT=3023 OPUTE_MCP_PREFIX_TOOL_NAMES=true OPUTE_HOST_AGENT_INSTANCE_ROOT=/tmp/e2e-agents/ws-a/instance OPUTE_STANDALONE_STATE_DIR=/tmp/e2e-agents/ws-a/state HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/ws-a/home timeout 30 /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent serve --transport http; echo exit=$?
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove ws-a && python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove ws-b
